result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no major layout breaks. The only findings are minor: a possibly missing profile avatar and some low-contrast gray text. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: The top-right profile control is a blank gray circle with only a red dot, so it looks like a missing avatar image or placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Show the user's avatar or initials, or a proper profile icon, and give the control an accessible label that describes its purpose and any notification state.

issues.description: The search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and the secondary gray delivery-fee and metadata text have fairly low contrast against their light gray or white backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder and secondary text so it meets WCAG AA contrast ratios (at least 4.5:1 for normal text).
